question: On the unchanged deterministic MuJoCo development cell, does the already-commissioned recovery controller progress without a phase skip from confirmed prone through measured distal support and measured body raising to the existing recovery-to-stance handoff, while the serial matched-zero arm stops failed and unactuated under the same frozen supervisor bounds?

controlled_change.changed_surface: Replace the predecessor's one-active-step campaign bound with the already-frozen 1,200-step supervisor maximum and evaluate the existing route's first natural stop. Add only a compact campaign projection for recovery-to-stance progression; production controller, route, physics, thresholds, and portable evaluator remain byte-unchanged.

threshold_and_margin_authority.threshold_provenance: Every numerical gate and timeout is the immutable R24D17 physical-development profile already consumed by the portable R24D26 route. R24D27 observes those existing gates and natural stops; it does not choose, tune, widen, narrow, or reinterpret any value.
threshold_and_margin_authority.adequacy_argument: The existing portable state machine can leave recovery ownership only after an observation satisfies distal_support_gate and a later observation satisfies both raised_body_gate and safety_gate. Reaching its already-declared stance_handoff phase is therefore the exact natural boundary of the commissioned recovery controller. The frozen per-phase and total timeouts give every failure a finite natural stop without inventing an intermediate step count or behavioral margin. This asks controller progression, not full prone-to-standing completion, repeatability, or population performance.

selected_development_cell.selection_provenance: This is the exact deterministic, outcome-exposed development cell used by R24D24 through R24D26. R24D27 asks what the unchanged controller does after the first qualified active command, so changing the cell or seed would confound that adjacent progression question.
selected_development_cell.selection_adequacy: One repeatable development cell can expose controller phase progression and implementation or physics failure. It cannot support a repeatability rate, held-out claim, population claim, robustness claim, or cross-engine recovery claim, and none is made.

ghost_horizon.stop_rule: Each serial arm stops immediately after the portable step first returns stance_handoff, complete, failed, or refused. The 1,200-step value is a maximum inherited from the physical threshold profile, not a fixed execution length or a newly selected outcome threshold.
derivation: The R24D26 trace proves the first active application but deliberately ends before the controller can answer its own next phase question.
The production route already stops before stepping an uncommissioned stance phase and already stops on every portable terminal.
The portable physical profile already bounds every arm at 1,200 total observations and also bounds establish_distal_support and raise_body at 240 and 600 phase observations.

Running to the first existing natural stop therefore covers the entire commissioned recovery controller without selecting an arbitrary intermediate horizon or stepping an uncommissioned stance controller.
coverage_manifest: execute the exact R24D26-qualified V2 context, observer, controller, native application, collection, and portable evaluation route
retain every observation, native application receipt, collector receipt, portable step receipt, and transition through the first natural stop
require both paired arms to stop naturally within the frozen bound and prohibit stepping after a terminal or recovery-to-stance handoff
evaluate candidate progression through confirm_prone, establish_distal_support, raise_body, and stance_handoff without a phase skip
require measured distal-support, raised-body, and safety gates on the transitions that consume them
require the matched-zero arm to remain unactuated and stop failed for a positive progression decision
retain the portable full-recovery verdict unchanged even though it answers a broader question than this campaign
ghost_horizon.adequacy: The natural stop eliminates repeated arbitrary micro-horizons. It is long enough to observe either the entire currently commissioned recovery controller or its frozen timeout, and no longer than the already-published total supervisor bound. The serial paired design retains the unchanged negative control while opening only two genuine worlds.

execution_valid_requires: both serial arms construct exactly one genuine MuJoCo model and world
both arms stop at their first existing route stop within the frozen 1,200-step maximum
every retained observation, native receipt, collector receipt, and portable receipt is complete and count-consistent
every active application receipt contains eight built-in JSON boolean clamp facts
all context, observer, route, initializer, mapping, intervention, support-status, and joint-limit invariants pass
the paired V2 evaluator accepts every supplied observation as a valid physical development trace
the portable broader recovery verdict and all no-claim fields are retained unchanged
the full trace, compact projection, manifest, reservation, and supervisor completion publish append-only
positive_requires: the candidate stops at stance_handoff with no terminal failure
the candidate's exact transition sequence is confirm_prone to establish_distal_support to raise_body to stance_handoff with no skip
the establish_distal_support to raise_body transition observation reports distal_support_gate true
the raise_body to stance_handoff transition observation reports raised_body_gate and safety_gate true
the candidate applies the recovery controller continuously after the twelve confirmation observations and beyond the single R24D26 application
the matched-zero arm remains unactuated on every step and stops failed with a concrete frozen supervisor failure code
both natural stops occur within the frozen 1,200-step per-arm maximum
decision_rule.valid_negative: An execution-valid run is retained and closed as a development negative if the candidate reaches a frozen terminal before stance_handoff, skips or lacks a required measured transition, or the matched-zero arm does not remain an unactuated failed control. The exact observed phase, gate, failure code, and trajectory remain visible.
decision_rule.invalid_or_incomplete: A source, qualification, schema, route, in-run invariant, publication, operation-lock, trace-completeness, or stop-boundary failure is retained as invalid or incomplete and cannot answer the controller-progression question.

natural_progression_decision_controls: candidate terminal failure cannot satisfy recovery-to-stance progression
a phase skip cannot satisfy the exact ordered progression
a missing measured raised-body gate cannot satisfy handoff
only the already-proven first active application cannot satisfy continued controller execution
a nonterminal matched-zero arm cannot satisfy the natural failed control
any matched-zero actuation cannot satisfy the unactuated control

physical_opening_conditions: the complete R24D27 development zero-world gate and all thirty-one controls pass on the final source
the retained R24D26 real trace passes the new projection reader only as a known incomplete negative
the exact contract, unchanged production route dependencies, worker, audit, and wrappers are committed and pushed
one official qualification receipt binds that exact clean-pushed source head
local HEAD, upstream main, and live origin/main remain exactly equal and the worktree remains clean
the global locomotion operation lock is held with role physical
only the declared repeatable development cell opens and paired arms execute serially
all evidence is written append-only under the declared durable evidence root
